blocks.x: When you were talking about Roy Eldridge joing Gene Krupa and he took his music with him and he changed the name of all the tunes and a number called "Nothing Yet," became "Balls of Fire" and then you said it was the theme of a film "Balls of Fire".
How did that come about that Roy Eldridge theme get to Hollywood?
He was with Krupa's band at the time.
Yeah, but how did-Krupa's band didn't play in the film did it?
Oh, I'm sorry, that I didn't realize. So did they appear in the film or just play the music.
I think they just played the music. They may have been seen, I didn't see the picture. Still have-
